{{- if eq .Values.global.userPlaneArchitecture "single" }}

apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: {{ include "free5gc-upf.fullname" $ }}-{{ .name }}-configmap
  labels:
    app: {{ $.Values.global.projectName }}
data:
  upfcfg.yaml: |
    version: 1.0.3
    description: UPF initial local configuration

    # The listen IP and nodeID of the N4 interface on this UPF (Can't set to 0.0.0.0)
    pfcp:
{{- if $.Values.global.upf.multus.enabled }}
      addr: {{ $.Values.global.upf.multus.upf.n4if.ipAddress }} # IP addr for listening
      nodeID: {{ $.Values.global.upf.multus.upf.n4if.ipAddress }} # External IP or FQDN can be reached
{{- else }}
      addr: POD_IP_ADDR # IP addr for listening - replaced at runtime
      nodeID: POD_IP_ADDR # External IP or FQDN can be reached - replaced at runtime
{{- end }}
      retransTimeout: 1s # retransmission timeout
      maxRetrans: 3 # the max number of retransmission

    gtpu:
      forwarder: gtp5g
      # The IP list of the N3/N9 interfaces on this UPF
      # If there are multiple connection, set addr to 0.0.0.0 or list all the addresses
      ifList:
{{- if $.Values.global.upf.multus.enabled }}
        - addr: {{ $.Values.global.upf.multus.upf.n3if.ipAddress }}
          type: N3
{{- else }}
        - addr: POD_IP_ADDR
          type: N3
{{- end }}
          # name: upf.5gc.nctu.me
          # ifname: gtpif

    {{- toYaml .configuration | nindent 4 }}

  wrapper.sh: |
    #!/bin/sh
    set -e

{{- if $.Values.global.upf.multus.enabled }}
    # Multus mode: Static IPs and dedicated interfaces are configured
    echo "[wrapper] Multus mode enabled - using dedicated interfaces"
    
    # Setup networking rules
    iptables -A FORWARD -j ACCEPT
    iptables -t nat -A POSTROUTING -s {{ $.Values.global.uesubnet }} -o n6 -j MASQUERADE
    echo "1200 n6if" >> /etc/iproute2/rt_tables
    ip rule add from {{ $.Values.global.uesubnet }} table n6if
    ip route add default via {{ $.Values.global.upf.multus.n6network.gatewayIP }} dev n6 table n6if

    {{- if $.Values.upf.configmap.wrapperAdditionalCommands }}
    {{- $.Values.upf.configmap.wrapperAdditionalCommands | nindent 4 }}
    {{- end }}

    exec /free5gc/upf -c {{ .volume.mount }}/upfcfg.yaml
{{- else }}
    # Dynamic Pod IP mode: Single interface (eth0)
    # Get Pod IP dynamically
    POD_IP=$(hostname -i | awk '{print $1}')
    echo "[wrapper] UPF Pod IP detected: $POD_IP"

    # Copy config to writable location
    cp {{ .volume.mount }}/upfcfg.yaml /tmp/upfcfg.yaml

    # Replace POD_IP_ADDR placeholder with actual Pod IP
    sed -i "s/POD_IP_ADDR/$POD_IP/g" /tmp/upfcfg.yaml

    echo "[wrapper] UPF PFCP config:"
    cat /tmp/upfcfg.yaml | grep -A3 "pfcp:"

    # Wait for upfgtp interface to be created by gtp5g module
    echo "[wrapper] Waiting for upfgtp interface..."
    for i in $(seq 1 30); do
      if ip link show upfgtp > /dev/null 2>&1; then
        echo "[wrapper] upfgtp interface is ready"
        break
      fi
      sleep 1
    done

    {{- if $.Values.upf.configmap.wrapperAdditionalCommands }}
    {{- $.Values.upf.configmap.wrapperAdditionalCommands | nindent 4 }}
    {{- end }}

    echo "[wrapper] Starting UPF with dynamic config"
    exec /free5gc/upf -c /tmp/upfcfg.yaml
{{- end }}

{{- end }}
{{- end }}

apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: {{ include "free5gc-upf.fullname" $ }}-{{ .name }}-configmap
  labels:
    app: {{ $.Values.global.projectName }}
data:
  upfcfg.yaml: |
    version: 1.0.3
    description: UPF initial local configuration

    # The listen IP and nodeID of the N4 interface on this UPF (Can't set to 0.0.0.0)
    pfcp:
{{- if $.Values.global.upf.multus.enabled }}
      addr: {{ $.Values.global.upf.multus.upf.n4if.ipAddress }} # IP addr for listening
      nodeID: {{ $.Values.global.upf.multus.upf.n4if.ipAddress }} # External IP or FQDN can be reached
{{- else }}
      addr: POD_IP_ADDR # IP addr for listening - replaced at runtime
      nodeID: POD_IP_ADDR # External IP or FQDN can be reached - replaced at runtime
{{- end }}
      retransTimeout: 1s # retransmission timeout
      maxRetrans: 3 # the max number of retransmission

    gtpu:
      forwarder: gtp5g
      # The IP list of the N3/N9 interfaces on this UPF
      # If there are multiple connection, set addr to 0.0.0.0 or list all the addresses
      ifList:
{{- if $.Values.global.upf.multus.enabled }}
        - addr: {{ $.Values.global.upf.multus.upf.n3if.ipAddress }}
          type: N3
{{- else }}
        - addr: POD_IP_ADDR
          type: N3
{{- end }}
          # name: upf.5gc.nctu.me
          # ifname: gtpif

    {{- toYaml .configuration | nindent 4 }}

  wrapper.sh: |
    #!/bin/sh
    set -e

{{- if $.Values.global.upf.multus.enabled }}
    # Multus mode: Static IPs and dedicated interfaces are configured
    echo "[wrapper] Multus mode enabled - using dedicated interfaces"
    
    # Setup networking rules
    iptables -A FORWARD -j ACCEPT
    iptables -t nat -A POSTROUTING -s {{ $.Values.global.uesubnet }} -o n6 -j MASQUERADE
    echo "1200 n6if" >> /etc/iproute2/rt_tables
    ip rule add from {{ $.Values.global.uesubnet }} table n6if
    ip route add default via {{ $.Values.global.upf.multus.n6network.gatewayIP }} dev n6 table n6if

    {{- if $.Values.upf.configmap.wrapperAdditionalCommands }}
    {{- $.Values.upf.configmap.wrapperAdditionalCommands | nindent 4 }}
    {{- end }}

    exec /free5gc/upf -c {{ .volume.mount }}/upfcfg.yaml
{{- else }}
    # Dynamic Pod IP mode: Single interface (eth0)
    # Get Pod IP dynamically
    POD_IP=$(hostname -i | awk '{print $1}')
    echo "[wrapper] UPF Pod IP detected: $POD_IP"

    # Copy config to writable location
    cp {{ .volume.mount }}/upfcfg.yaml /tmp/upfcfg.yaml

    # Replace POD_IP_ADDR placeholder with actual Pod IP
    sed -i "s/POD_IP_ADDR/$POD_IP/g" /tmp/upfcfg.yaml

    echo "[wrapper] UPF PFCP config:"
    cat /tmp/upfcfg.yaml | grep -A3 "pfcp:"

    # Wait for upfgtp interface to be created by gtp5g module
    echo "[wrapper] Waiting for upfgtp interface..."
    for i in $(seq 1 30); do
      if ip link show upfgtp > /dev/null 2>&1; then
        echo "[wrapper] upfgtp interface is ready"
        break
      fi
      sleep 1
    done

    {{- if $.Values.upf.configmap.wrapperAdditionalCommands }}
    {{- $.Values.upf.configmap.wrapperAdditionalCommands | nindent 4 }}
    {{- end }}

    echo "[wrapper] Starting UPF with dynamic config"
    exec /free5gc/upf -c /tmp/upfcfg.yaml
{{- end }}

{{- end }}
{{- end }}

content.text:
free5GC v4.3.0 核心網路和 UERANSIM 已部署完成，UE 已註冊並建立 PDU session。我從 UE 的 `uesimtun0` ping 8.8.8.8 成功。

## (1) 部署內容與設定

Helm chart 用 `free5gc-helm` 的 commit `07139fcc…`（已 `git checkout` 確認）。所有 image 都是 `free5gc/*:v4.3.0`，gNB 和 UE 用 `free5gc/ueransim:v4.0.1`。

Namespace 是 `free5gc`，有兩個 release：

- **`free5gc-helm`**（核心網路）：AMF、SMF、UPF、NRF、AUSF、UDM、UDR、PCF、NSSF、CHF、NEF、BSF、SCP、WebUI 和 MongoDB，共 15 個 pod，全部 `1/1 Running`。
- **`ueransim`**：1 個 gNB 和 1 個 UE。

設定檔放在 `/home/vagrant/work/deploy/`（`free5gc-values.yaml`、`ueransim-values.yaml`、`subscriber.json`）。我在 chart 預設值上做了這些覆寫：

- **架構**：`userPlaneArchitecture: single`，也就是 1 個 UPF。chart 預設是 ulcl（3 個 UPF）。這個 chart 的非 Multus 模式用 Pod IP 通訊，所以沒有裝 Multus。
- **PLMN／slice／DNN**：PLMN 是 208/93，TAC 是 1，只有一個 slice（SST 1、SD 010203），DNN 只有 `internet`。AMF 預設有兩個 slice，我刪掉了 112233。NSSF 的 `supportedNssaiInPlmnList` 也縮成單一 slice。
- **UPF NAT**：預設的 `natIfCIDR` 是 `192.168.0.0/16`，和這台 K3s 的 pod 網段對不上。我改成 `10.42.0.0/16`，並指定 `natifname: eth0`。UE 的位址池是 10.60.0.0/16，DNS 是 8.8.8.8。
- **MongoDB 儲存**：chart 內建的 PV 綁在 hostname `free5gc` 和 `microk8s-hostpath` 上，在本機節點 `oam-node1` 無法排程，pod 一直 Pending。我關掉那個 PV，改用 K3s 內建的 `local-path`。
- **Subscriber**：用 WebUI API（admin/free5gc）建立 `imsi-208930000000001`。金鑰是 UERANSIM 的預設值，OPC 認證，AMF 欄位是 8000，並訂閱 slice 1/010203 和 DNN `internet`。
- **UE**：UE 的 `default-nssai` 預設是 `sd: 1`，和其他設定不一致，我改成 `0x010203`。

## (2) 驗證方式

- **gNB 與 AMF**：gNB 日誌顯示 SCTP 連線成功，NG Setup 成功。
- **UE 註冊**：UE 日誌依序出現 Authentication、Security Mode、Registration accept，以及 `Initial Registration is successful`。
- **PDU session**：UE 日誌出現 `PDU Session establishment is successful PSI[1]`，並建立 `uesimtun0`，位址是 10.60.0.1。
- **SMF 與 UPF**：SMF 日誌顯示和 UPF 完成 PFCP association，也完成 PFCP session establishment。SMF 配發的 UE 位址是 10.60.0.1。
- **連網測試**：`ping -I uesimtun0 8.8.8.8` 送 4 個封包，收 4 個，0% loss，延遲約 9 ms。`ping -I uesimtun0 google.com` 送 2 個、收 2 個，DNS 解析也正常。
